description:
Disposable email domain checker

Checks the domain against a continuously updated blocklist of known
throwaway email services (Mailinator, Guerrilla Mail, 10minutemail, etc.).

Cost: 1 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
name: validation.email.disposable
